usedFor: Evenium holds event guests, and MailerLite keeps them as subscribers through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “Guest Created or Updated” in Evenium, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: It covers new and edited guests, and the action creates or updates the subscriber, so the list stays current.

watchOut: “Guest Created or Updated” is polling and fires on edits too, so the same guest can run twice.
